PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
                                    MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, July 16, 2024, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Scott Roybal, Chainnan, Pete Layboum, Dr. Rinne, and Tom
Segrave.


                                     AGENDA ITEMS

7.     ORDINANCE —3 READING              Amending Section 10.16.150, Parking Violation
                                            -




       Hearings and Appeal Procedures, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne,
       Wyoming, modifying the procedures governing the Administrative Review of Parking
       Citations, making confonning amendments and repealing an obsolete provision.

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3” and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Captain David Janes, Police Department, provided a staff report.

8.     ORDINANCE —3”’ READING           — Creating Section 10.60.015, Paid On-Street Parking
       Districts; Establishment, Administration, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne,
       Wyoming, establishing the Paid On-Street Parking Districts Program and making
       conforming amendments as specified.

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3”’ and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Mr. Segrave
moved to amend by substitute dated July 10, 2024, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend
carried by unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Captain David Janes, Police Department, provided a staff report and proposed a substitute the
proposed ordinance. Tom Cobb, City Engineer, advised that moving forward with parking
modifications would trigger signage changes. Committee member Laybourn commented on the
item.

Il.    RESOLUTION Certifying compliance with Wyoming Statute § 15-1-402 for the City-
                       —




       initiated annexation of tracts of land situate in portions of Sections 4 and 5, T13N, R67W,
       6th
           P.M., Laramie County, Wyoming (also known as ‘North Range Business Park’, located
       northwest of the 1-80 and Roundtop Road interchange). (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                                                                             —




Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Director, provided a staff report. Committee members
Laybourn and Segrave commented on the item.
